coaching.headline: Out-majored 16-28 and won by 46 VP — a pure conversion win: five of six won fights cashed, and the last three fights took the base.
coaching.team: The mid-game was genuinely lost — 0-3 at 13.8, then 0-2s at our outer towers at 18.3 and 20.3, with the macro flagging fights taken while half the team never joined (16.6, 18.3, 20.3). They held Fangtooth at 15 and 21 and three Genesis spawns. The flip was conversion: we won 6 fights and cashed 5 — Fangtooth 26, Primal 32, Orb 38, Primal 39 — while their six wins cashed four; the late game was played five-strong around spawned objectives.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 31.8 and 37.1 picks at their inhibitor (2-0 each, the second opened a body down and still won) plus the 37.9 2-0 at our Orb — three fights in six minutes that banked Orb, Primal and the base.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco's line is a support masterclass by volume: 15 assists, 17 wards, on 3 deaths in 40 minutes. The support lane read flipped from theirs early to ours late — exactly when the team started cashing. One cut: the 21.2 solo catch by TwinBlast during the stretch when the team was already bleeding towers.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow carried the win condition: 17/5 with 24.2k objective damage, and the late picks (31.8, 37.1, 39.4) were the game. The two costs worth naming: caught at 9.4 rotating alone, and the 14-15 minute deaths sat inside the window that gave Fangtooth plus two towers. The Vanquisher spike at ~24 is when the film turns — before it, fewer fights; after it, all of them.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
enemyKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

sparrow.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Endless Hunt, crest Pacifier
fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,727 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Sparrow carry players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Imperator.
22 takedowns (17 kills, 5 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 69,085 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +297 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 133 physical armor, 88 after penetration) and Howitzer (level 17 estimated: about 113 physical armor, 73 after penetration) that is about 24% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 4,606 healing recorded.

Lesson: Sparrow's penetration cut through: Khaimera took about 24% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 133, about 88 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
